desc: Implement coordinate compression for all $A_i$ values and handle $X_i$ queries by mapping them to the compressed domain (using bisect_right to find the largest compressed value $\le X_i$).
Build a segment tree over the compressed value domain that supports point update (set value at index to max of current and new value) and range maximum query.

Process the array $A$ from left to right. For each element $A_j$, compute the LIS length ending at $A_j$ by querying the segment tree for max in range $[1, \text{compressed}(A_j)-1]$, then update the segment tree at position $\text{compressed}(A_j)$ with this length + 1.
After processing $A_j$, answer all queries with $R_i = j$ by querying the segment tree for max in range $[1, \text{compressed\_index\_for}(X_i)]$.
Store and print all answers in the original query order.
